source_dataset.normalization_policy: No Ibiza statistics are computed; each checkpoint applies its embedded KLT3 StandardizeLayer through strict load_state_dict.
source_dataset.rinex_preprocessing_policy: Reuse this exact frozen NPZ; do not preprocess RINEX during the batch run.

checkpoint_inventory.load_policy: Verify SHA-256 over the exact bytes before deserialization; strict state_dict loading; eval and inference modes only.

paper_numerical_provenance.note: The frozen NPZ already contains paper-era preprocessing products; inference reuses the validated project-side networks and WLS.

runtime_versions.run_manifest_policy: Record actual Python, NumPy, Torch, pymap3d, OS, machine, device, dtype, and paper-provenance versions at execution time.

common_epoch_policy.selection: All 2856 accepted Ibiza epochs in accepted-epoch index order 0..2855.
common_epoch_policy.satellite_row_policy: Retain each epoch's contiguous NPZ row interval and original satellite ordering.
common_epoch_policy.failed_solution_policy: Write one explicit exception row with known source metadata and nullable solve/output fields; never omit an epoch.
common_epoch_policy.ground_truth_policy: Reject ground-truth/reference-coordinate arrays; do not calculate positioning error or accuracy.

result_layout.per_model_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one canonical key-sorted object per accepted epoch; newline terminated.
result_layout.write_policy: Write each file through a same-directory temporary file and atomically replace its target; refuse existing targets unless --overwrite is explicit.

result_schema.source_ibiza_npz_sha256: string; identical required Ibiza hash in every row
result_schema.estimated_ecef_m: three floats or null on an exception/non-finite state
result_schema.estimated_receiver_state: seven floats or null on an exception/non-finite state
result_schema.condition_number: finite float or null when unavailable/non-finite

model_output.weight_fraction_lt_0_01: float or null; established descriptive GNSS-weight threshold, not a failure criterion
model_output.bias_fraction_eq_0: float or null; TDL-BW ReLU-head diagnostic
model_output.bias_fraction_gt_0: float or null; TDL-BW ReLU-head diagnostic

result_schema.error: null for completed evaluation or {type, message} for an explicitly retained exception

scientific_exclusions: No ground truth or trusted Ibiza coordinate
